ModMetaData.name: RimAI.Communication.Memory
ModMetaData.author: SANGUO
ModMetaData.description:
RimAI.Communication.Memory gives colonists layered conversation memory so they remember more and stay consistent over time.
It works with RimAI.Communication. Recent and longer-term memories, optional background knowledge, and a timeline you can review, summarize, or archive stay in this module.
Requires Harmony and RimAI.Communication. Load after both. Gameplay text AI uses shared RimAI settings.
Attribution: Juicy (original Communication/RimTalk author).
